units.text: § 3. Selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) using closed competitive methods
units.label: § 3. Selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) using closed competitive methods

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.label: Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 1. When closed competitive methods are used:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 1) the contracting authority shall develop and approve procurement documentation containing:
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: а) the information and documents specified in Article 42, paragraph 1(1)–(13) and (15)–(24), and paragraph 2(1)–(6), of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: б) the place and procedure for submitting procurement applications and the application form, for a closed tender or closed auction;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: в) the time of the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), for a closed auction;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: г) the period within which the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection or, in cases provided for by this Federal Law, another participant must sign the contract, for a closed tender or closed auction;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: д) the procedure for a participant to withdraw or amend its submitted application, and the procedure for returning applications under this Federal Law. This information shall be included in the procurement documentation for a closed tender or closed auction;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 2) the invitation, procurement documentation, amendments and clarifications to it, the draft contract, records drawn up or generated in the course of procurement, and information and documents entered under this Federal Law in the register provided for in Article 99(21) of this Federal Law shall not be posted on the official website or published in the mass media;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 3) procurement documentation and its amendments may not be provided, requests to inspect it, receive it or obtain clarification of it may not be sent, and such clarification may not be provided in electronic document form, except in closed electronic procedures;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 4) audio and video recording is prohibited unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 5) when a contract is concluded in the procedure established by Article 73(14) of this Federal Law, the unified information system shall not be used and no information or documents shall be posted in it or on the specialized electronic platform.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 2. A closed tender or closed auction requires approval from the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation. To obtain approval, the contracting authority, or an authorized body or institution vested with the relevant powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law, shall send that federal executive body a request for approval containing:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 1) justification that the closed tender or closed auction falls within the cases specified in Article 24(11)(1) and (2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 2) the information and documents specified in Article 42, paragraph 1(1), (3), (5)–(9), (12), (13), (15) and (19), and paragraph 2(1), of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 3) information on procurement participants capable of supplying the goods, performing the works or providing the services that are the subject matter of procurement.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 3. The federal executive body specified in paragraph 2 of this Article must examine the request for approval of a closed tender or closed auction within ten working days from the day following receipt. It shall then decide to grant or refuse approval. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the approval procedure, providing, in particular, for:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 1) the procedure for submitting a request for approval of a closed tender or closed auction and the form of the request;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 2) the procedure for examining the request and the grounds for deciding to grant or refuse approval of a closed tender or closed auction;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Use of closed competitive methods
units.text: 3) the procedure for sending a decision granting or refusing approval of a closed tender or closed auction.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.label: Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1. For a closed tender, the contracting authority shall simultaneously send invitations to all participants specified in Article 72(2)(3) of this Federal Law no later than one hundred and eighty days from the decision approving the closed tender, but no later than fifteen working days before the application deadline. No later than one working day following dispatch, it shall send copies of those invitations to the federal executive body specified in Article 72(2) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2. The invitation must contain the following information:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) the information specified in Article 42(1)(1)–(3), (5)–(10), (12), (13), (15)–(19) and (21) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) the procedure for sending the requests provided for in paragraph 3 of this Article, the procedures for inspecting and obtaining procurement documentation, and the amount and payment procedure of any fee for providing that documentation established under this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 3. A participant that has received an invitation may send the contracting authority a written request to inspect or receive the procurement documentation. Inspection or provision of the documentation shall take place as follows:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) no later than two working days from receipt of a request to inspect the procurement documentation, if received at least four working days before the application deadline, the contracting authority must make the documentation available for inspection;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) no later than two working days from receipt of a request for procurement documentation, if received at least four working days before the application deadline, the contracting authority must provide the documentation in writing, subject to the participant’s payment of any fee established by the contracting authority. The fee must not exceed the contracting authority’s costs of making a copy of the documentation.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 4. A participant that has received an invitation may send the contracting authority a written request for clarification of the procurement documentation. No later than two working days from the day following receipt of the request, the contracting authority shall send the participant a clarification, provided that the request was received at least three days before the application deadline. Clarifications must not change the substance of the procurement documentation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 5. On its own initiative or in response to a request under paragraph 4 of this Article, the contracting authority may amend the procurement documentation no later than one working day before the application deadline. It may not change the name of the procurement subject matter or increase the amount of application security. No later than two working days following the amendments, but at least one working day before the application deadline, it shall send them to all participants that received the procurement documentation or, if the amendments concern information included in the invitation under paragraph 2(1) of this Article, to all participants sent an invitation. The application period must be extended so that at least ten days remain from the day following dispatch of the amendments to the application deadline. If the amendments concern a lot formed under this Federal Law, the application period must be extended for that lot.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 6. Only a participant that has received an invitation may submit a procurement application. It may do so at any time from receiving the invitation until the application deadline.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 7. In a closed tender, the procurement application must contain:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) the information and documents specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law: point 1, subpoints “а”, “в”–“е”, “з”–“к” and “м”–“р”, and points 2–5;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) an extract (or a copy) from the Unified State Register of Legal Entities, if the participant is a legal entity, or from the Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs, if the participant is an individual entrepreneur;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 3) information and documents (or copies) confirming provision of application security, if required by this Federal Law, and information and documents under Article 37(4) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 4) a document (or copy) confirming the signatory’s authority to act on behalf of the participant, except where the application is signed by the individual, including an individual entrepreneur, who is the participant, or by a person listed in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities as entitled to act without a power of attorney on behalf of the legal entity, where the participant is a legal entity.
units.label: Point 4 Part 7 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 8. The contracting authority shall register every application received before the deadline specified in the procurement documentation, recording its receipt date and time. At the applicant’s request, it shall issue a receipt stating that date and time. The contracting authority shall safeguard the envelopes containing applications, prevent damage to them and ensure that applications are examined only after the envelopes have been opened. An application received after the deadline shall not be examined and shall be returned to the participant on the day it is received. If it contains no postal address for the participant, it shall be retained under Article 4(15) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 9. No earlier than the application deadline, the procurement commission shall open the envelopes containing applications received by the contracting authority before that deadline.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 10. No later than ten working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the date for determining supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results set in the procurement documentation:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: а) examine the applications received and decide, for each one, whether it complies with the procurement documentation or must be rejected;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: б) evaluate applications found to comply with the procurement documentation against the criteria provided for in Article 32(1) of this Federal Law, where such criteria are established in the documentation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: в) on the basis of the evaluation under subpoint “б” of this point, rank each application found to comply with the procurement documentation in descending order of the advantage of the contract performance terms offered, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first. If several applications offer identical contract performance terms, the application received earlier than the others offering the same terms shall receive the lower rank number;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall draw up the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results and, after it is signed by the procurement commission members, sign it and send:
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: а) one copy of the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results to the federal executive body specified in Article 72(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: б) to every participant that submitted an application, a notification containing the information specified in paragraph 12(2)–(4) of this Article concerning its application.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 11. A procurement application shall be rejected in the following cases:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 1) an application is submitted by a participant that has not been sent an invitation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 2) one participant submits two or more applications for the same procurement lot without withdrawing its previously submitted applications. In that case, all its applications shall be found not to meet the requirements in the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 3) the participant submits under this Federal Law an application containing an offer of the contract price, unit price of goods, works or services, or total of unit prices that exceeds, respectively, the initial (maximum) contract price, initial unit price or initial total of unit prices, or is equal to zero;
units.label: Point 3 Part 11 Art. 73

units.locator: Article 73. Conduct of a closed tender
units.text: 4) failure to provide the information and documents specified in paragraph 7 of this Article, except in cases provided for by this Federal Law, or failure of that information and those documents to meet the requirements in the procurement documentation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 11 Art. 73
